SRT.DialogHint.TriggerName: Internal name for this trigger. Example: Natural 20 on attack.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerDescription: Optional summary shown in the manager. Example: Posts a crit message and rolls a table.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerCategory: Free text grouping for your own organization. Example: combat, house-rule, social.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerPriority: Higher numbers run first when multiple triggers match. Example: 200 beats 100.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExecutionMode: Choose whether the trigger runs automatically, asks the GM, or appears as a chat button.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerMatchType: Defines what kind of dice result or system state should activate the trigger. Example: die maximum or total above threshold.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerFaces: Restrict the match to dice with this many faces. Example: 20 for d20 or 6 for d6.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerValue: Specific die result to look for. Example: 1 for a fumble or 20 for a natural 20.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerThreshold: Numeric cutoff used by above or below checks. Example: 15 means strictly greater than 15.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerMinCount: Minimum number of dice that must satisfy the condition. Example: 2 for doubles.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerDegree: System-specific success degree to match. Example: criticalSuccess or failure.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerPath: System flag path that must exist on the roll event. Example: dnd5e.critical.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExpression: JavaScript expression evaluated on the GM client against event. Example: event.total >= 18 && event.rollType === "attack".
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerRollTypes: Optional roll type filter. Example: attack, check, damage, or any.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerActorTypes: Optional actor type filter. Example: PC only, NPC only, or any actor.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerVisibilityFilter: Restrict matching to a roll visibility. Example: public only or blind only.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerCombatState: Restrict the trigger to combat or non-combat scenes.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerIncludeScenes: Only allow triggers from this scene. Example: limit a trap trigger to one dungeon scene.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerIncludeActors: Only allow triggers from this actor. Example: a cursed weapon trigger for one NPC.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerIncludeItems: Only allow triggers when this item is involved. Example: a specific sword or spell item.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerPlayerOnly: Only non-GM users can trigger this rule.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerGmOnly: Only the GM can trigger this rule.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerActionType: Choose what happens after a match. Example: chat message, roll table, macro, or journal link.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerActionVisibility: Controls who sees the action result. Example: public, GM whisper, or affected player.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerChatTemplate: Text template posted when the action runs. Example: Critical hit! Roll on the table.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerTables: Comma-separated roll table ids or uuids. Example: crit-table, RollTable.world.fumbles.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerMacro: Macro to execute when the trigger fires. Example: Apply Critical Effect.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerJournal: Journal entry to link in chat. Example: house-rule notes or injury rules.
